channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: MA Home Has ‘Catastrophic Damage’ After No Fire Hydrants, Frozen Lakes Slowed Response
item.description: A fire in Monson, MA, caused catastrophic damage to a home due to insufficient fire hydrants and frozen lakes hindering firefighters' efforts.

item.title: Two People, Five Dogs Rescued from Island in Swollen CA River
item.description: Firefighters rescued two people and five dogs from an island in the swollen Salinas River.

item.title: Adopt an Ownership Mentality
item.description: Ownership mentality in firefighting emphasizes accountability and personal investment in work. Frank Viscuso on why this is so important.

item.title: ID Firefighter Injured in July Shooting Retires
item.description: Coeur d'Alene firefighter David Tysdal has retired after 24 years due to life-threatening injuries sustained while warning others during a shooting incident on Canfield Mountain last summer.

item.title: What You Need to Know About the Pressurized Water Can
item.description: Why is the pressurized water can so important? Rick Lasky and John Salka discuss the reasons on this episode of The Command Post.

item.title: Crews Battle Stubborn Easton (PA) Fire; at Least One Injured
item.description: A fire on Northampton Street in Easton has left over 3,000 residents without power and at least one person injured.

item.title: NY Fire Captain Arrested for Alleged Forged Checks
item.description: A captain in the Glens Falls Fire Department was arrested for allegedly writing and cashing fraudulent checks from the fire union account.

item.title: One Dead, Three Injured in VA House Fire
item.description: One person died and three were injured in a house fire on Peppers Ferry Road in Christiansburg. The cause is under investigation by Virginia State Police and the State Fire Marshal's Office.

item.title: Wildfire Tears Through Rural MO Lake Community, Displacing Dozens
item.description: A wildfire in Ray County displaced dozens, destroying at least three homes. The American Red Cross and Salvation Army are providing assistance and shelter for affected residents.

item.title: Report: Wichita Disregards Internal Report on Critical Gaps in Fire Stations, Staffing
item.description: Wichita lacks sufficient fire stations and firefighters, missing national response time standards. City officials have known about these issues for years but failed to address them, impacting safety.
